spider.pricingTier: Pay-as-you-go bandwidth and compute; per-page heuristic
spider.pricingNotes: Spider pay-as-you-go lists $1 per GB of pre-transformation content plus $0.0001 per CPU minute, with $1 per 10,000 credits. The API reference example /scrape response reports total_cost 0.00011 USD for one page. AutoShow keeps a conservative per-page heuristic of $0.0012 (about a 1.2 MB page) for dry-run totals; unblocker and browser surcharges, free credits, discounts, Unlimited plans, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Spider publishes usage billing based on bandwidth and compute rather than a fixed per-page scrape price. AutoShow uses a conservative heuristic per-page estimate for dry-run totals.
